testEnvironment: Actual native archive CLI, Node registry reader/exporter and standardization/index builders operate on temporary v2/v3 projects. Valid-digest malformed ZIPs are built independently using yazl. Each damaged record is rejected by the Node reader before the native checks; backup bytes, original files and restored parent contents are compared. Compatible shared ownership, legacy optional fields, UTF-16 text limits, ECMAScript whitespace semantics, repeated own aliases and null fingerprints remain portable.
